name: ManualPaymentSubmission
description: Administrator-only manual payment verification and Premium period record

owner_email.description: Verified account email that submitted the payment

crypto_option_id.description: Selected cryptocurrency destination id when applicable

base_amount_usd.description: Fixed Premium base price in USD

claimed_amount.description: Amount the user says they paid

claimed_currency.description: Currency or crypto ticker the user says they paid

expected_amount.description: Amount calculated from the current instructions at submission time

expected_currency.description: Expected transfer currency, or USD for the crypto equivalent

exchange_rate.description: Captured manual conversion rate, or zero when no conversion applies

exchange_rate_mode.description: MANUAL for local bank conversion, NONE otherwise

exchange_rate_timestamp.description: Rate timestamp captured with the payment instructions

payment_date.description: Date and time the user says payment was made

admin_notification_status.description: Status of the safe administrator email notice

admin_notification_at.description: When the administrator email notice was processed

payer_notification_status.description: Status of the safe payer decision email notice

payer_notification_at.description: When the payer email notice was processed
